Tokuyama.evidence: Tokuyama results presentation 07-29-2026: Electronic & Advanced Materials segment covers semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon and high-purity IPA for electronic manufacturing; polycrystalline silicon factory under construction in Vietnam

players.product: semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon; high-purity isopropyl alcohol (IPA) for electronics manufacturing

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokuyama results briefing Q&A: Major Questions and Answers Q1 FY ending March 2027 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Yoshinori Katayama (Executive Officer, Deputy General Manager, Corporate Planning Division) at the Q1 briefing: the business environment for the company's polycrystalline silicon customers, the wafer manufacturers, remains firm, but inventory adjustments still remain across the supply chain; polycrystalline silicon is relatively easy to hold in inventory, so shipments currently appear somewhat sluggish; if downstream demand continues, he believes demand for the company's products will spread through the supply chain, albeit with a time lag. Polycrystalline silicon sales volume decreased year on year in Q1, while high-purity IPA performed steadily.

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokuyama results briefing Q&A: Major Questions and Answers Q1 FY ending March 2027 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Katayama on the Electronic & Advanced Materials sales outlook: IC chemicals (IPA) sales are expected to increase as demand remains firm, along with a higher operating rate at STAC in South Korea; for polycrystalline silicon the impact of supply-chain inventory adjustments remains and the company is closely monitoring downstream demand. IPA contract structures and terms differ by customer; the company is acting to maintain and improve profitability as raw material prices rise.
